title: Homemade Corn and Flour Tortillas
summary: Both soft flour tortillas and pressed corn tortillas, cooked on a dry, hot cast-iron pan.
equipment: 2 pieces of baking paper or a cut-open freezer bag

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Flour dough
steps.text: Mix the flour, salt and baking powder, add the oil and water and knead 2-3 min until smooth; divide into 8 balls and rest, covered, 30 min.

steps.title: Corn dough
steps.text: Mix the masa harina, salt, oil and most of the water to a soft dough like play dough, adding more water if it cracks; divide into 12 balls and keep covered.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll each flour ball into a thin 20 cm round; press each corn ball between the paper sheets to a 14 cm round.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Heat the dry cast-iron pan over medium-high; cook flour tortillas about 1 min each side until blistered with brown spots; cook corn tortillas 50 s, flip for 1 min, then flip back and press gently so they puff.

steps.title: Keep warm
steps.text: Stack in the tea towel as they come off the pan so they stay soft.

tips: If corn dough cracks at the edges, add a little water.
Keep cooked tortillas wrapped so they steam soft.
Rest the flour dough so it rolls easily.
storage: Keep wrapped in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat in a dry pan. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
